title: Nervous Kaomoji (^_^;): Copy & Paste Sweat Drop Text Faces
meta_description: Copy and paste nervous kaomoji with a sweat drop: (^_^;), (・_・;), (;´Д`A ```, worried faces like (´･_･`) and awkward ones like (-_-;) and ┐(￣ヘ￣;)┌.
hero_tagline: Sweat drops, forced smiles and worried frowns for the moments a plain smile would be a lie. A single tap copies the face you pick.
intro: The mark that makes a kaomoji nervous is the semicolon. In (^_^;) the ; sits outside the eye, where manga artists draw a single big drop of sweat beside a character's head when they are embarrassed, caught out or under pressure. Two or three of them, as in (;;;･_･), turn that into sweating buckets. Read the eyes before you send one: in (;_;) the semicolons are the eyes themselves, with a tear running down, so that face is crying rather than nervous. The 〃 mark works like a small sweat or blush line, and ゞ at the end is a hand scratching the back of the head. Every face here is plain text, so it works in any chat, comment or caption.

faq.a: It is a drop of sweat on the side of the face, taken from manga, where a large sweat drop by a character's head shows embarrassment or nervousness. The face means roughly the same as the 😅 emoji.
No. In (;_;) the semicolons are the eyes, with the comma part as a tear, so it is a crying face. A nervous face keeps normal eyes and puts the ; outside them, as in (・_・;).

faq.q: What is the difference between a nervous and an awkward kaomoji?
faq.a: Nervous faces react to something that has not happened yet, so they use wide or shifting eyes. Awkward faces react to something that already went wrong, so they use flat mouths like ー and _ and a sideways look.
